name: Sunday Times cryptic crossword, Penguin book 2 No 41

clue.text: Body of ideas that makes one goodly disturbance around the East!
Continue in the same place — about by the sea
To dress certain ones is boring
Money gets old pure fine soft stuff
Create a small scene to curl a cylinder of parchment
Her Grace gets in a tizzy — has to fill up again
Hit and run is rash!
A door with a bit missing — skilful and absolutely charming
Film man, one of the board
They sound like a crazy person to the French
Rising prices?
Habits are important to him — essential in his trade, indeed
Wood chopped up again without an arcade to be con- structed
Not how the weakling behaves, presumably
Be backward in payments for the local authority to obtain discounts!
Conveyance used for the disabled at spring sessions?
‘Old times unqueen thee, and old loves — thee’ (Hartley Coleridge: To a Lofty Beauty)
Person deeply concerned with curious social occasion
Sure can’t change an old Italian!
Victor is not among Rapallo’s errand boys!
During storms, doctor takes great risks
Fire payment
A number of heavy blows — astounding!
A couple of letters in an old garment
Lamb follows a clumsy person — what a bloomer!
Unusually right and early perhaps
Set-to in game?
